headline: German Producer Prices Surge 8.1% Year-on-Year in October
summary: German producer prices jumped 8.1% in October compared to the prior year. The sharp increase reflects broader inflationary pressures across Europe's largest economy.
why: Producer price indices measure wholesale inflation at the factory gate, often serving as a leading indicator for consumer inflation and European Central Bank policy.
why_moved: Producer inflation significantly exceeded expectations, signaling persistent cost pressure across German industrial sectors.
